description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Metastatic Evangel and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, causing you to proliferate and get {E}.
Repeat.
